data.name: Description
data.value: Your own BorgStudio Server: pair once, then pick or create repositories there; keys, quota and statistics are handled by the server.

data.name: RepositoryRequired
data.value: Please choose a repository on the server or enter a name for a new one.

data.name: NotPaired
data.value: BorgStudio is not paired with the server {0}. Pair it under Settings or in the repository's editor.

data.name: TokenLocked
data.value: The access to the server {0} is in the vault, which is locked.

data.name: RepositoryNotFound
data.value: The repository does not exist on the server (any more), or this account has no access to it.

data.name: NotAServer
data.value: {0} does not answer like a BorgStudio Server. Check the address (e.g. https://backup.example.org:8443).

data.name: CertificateChanged
data.value: The server {0} presented a different certificate than the one confirmed. If it was renewed on purpose, pair again; otherwise someone may be in between.

data.name: Revoked
data.value: The server {0} no longer accepts this computer: its pairing was revoked. Pair it again.
